hints.title: Running Binary Bitshift
hints.text: As you descend down the tree path, each node adds its bit to the least significant place: current value becomes (current << 1) | node value.

hints.title: Leaf Detection
hints.text: When a node has neither a left child nor a right child, it is a leaf, and the running value represents the completed binary number for this path.

hints.title: Subtree Summation
hints.text: If a node is null, return 0. If it is a leaf, return the accumulated value. Otherwise, return the sum of the recursive calls on its left and right children.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting paths as binary strings and converting them afterwards incurs extra string allocations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Computing numbers inline during DFS requires only recursion stack memory O(H) and single-pass traversal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that bitshift accumulator (val << 1) | bit computes path values cleanly.
complexity.notes: H is O(log N) for balanced trees and O(N) for degenerate trees.
